author_artifact_boundary: The Zenodo author code/data locator was not opened; source figures and numerical arrays were not used as scientific inputs.
conclusion: Publication omission is proven for T001's finite scattering-amplitude rendering and T005's absolute phonon contribution. It is not proven for T006-T008: the source prints the global density parameters, equilibrium constraint, masses, operating point, analytic three-fluid equations, and all six fitted coefficients; per-species densities are model-derived quantities rather than indispensable unpublished inputs.

target_findings.direct_cause: The Supplemental equations specify an i0+ resonance pole but no finite linewidth or numerical regularization used to draw the finite |f(E)| peak; the displayed curve is not uniquely defined by the printed expression.
target_findings.root_cause: No value or rule for replacing i0+ with the plotted finite-width convention appears in the PDF or TeX source.
target_findings.scope: Only the right-hand scattering-amplitude series of Main Fig. 1(b).
target_findings.resolution_input: A citable linewidth/regularization convention and its parameter value.

target_findings.direct_cause: The manuscript states that rho_ph is estimated from Refs. Lavasani2019 and Huang2024 but prints neither the acoustic-phonon relaxation-time function nor its material calibration used in the inset.
target_findings.root_cause: The absolute phonon curve is delegated to external literature without a source-to-curve parameter mapping, so the total-resistivity inset cannot be uniquely regenerated from the publication package.
target_findings.scope: Only the near-resonant total-resistivity inset series; the independently implemented many-body contribution is outside this blocker.
target_findings.resolution_input: The material-specific tau_ph(T) calibration and normalization used for the plotted inset.

target_findings.direct_cause: The independently implemented far-detuned Drude-plus-phonon limit still requires the same absolute acoustic-phonon relaxation-time calibration, which the manuscript only delegates to Refs. Lavasani2019 and Huang2024.
target_findings.root_cause: No tau_ph(T) function, material constants, or source-to-curve normalization is printed in the PDF or TeX source, so the absolute far-detuned total-resistivity curve is not uniquely fixed.
target_findings.scope: Only the far-detuned total-resistivity inset series; its implemented asymptotic many-body/Drude contribution remains valid evidence.
target_findings.resolution_input: The material-specific tau_ph(T) calibration and normalization used for the plotted inset.

contrary_publication_evidence: Main parameter paragraph: EFh=5 meV, nx=2e11 cm^-2, masses and tau0
Main Fig. 4 caption: Delta/EFh=0.5 and T=5.8 K
Supplement hydrodynamic section: printed equations and all six fitted tau/alpha coefficients
target_findings.reason: The species densities used by the three-fluid model can be reconstructed from the printed equilibrium model. The remaining mismatch must be tested as a density-convention/model/evidence issue, not closed as an external publication blocker.
target_findings.deciding_test: Independently solve both plausible free-density and conserved-total-density closures at the printed operating point, evaluate the analytic and direct-matrix three-fluid forms, and adjudicate the curves against the frozen kinetic output.
